paragraphs: Rav Mesharshiya of Tusnaya is mentioned in Yevamot 21b: he sent to Rav Pappi, “Let our master teach us,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: כא: gives Yevamot 21b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification.

The supplied מתוסנייא and catalog מתוסניא are separate textual layers, not two freshly collated printed witnesses. Mesharshiya sends to Pappi; ילמדנו רבינו is rendered once as Let our master teach us, with the source’s etc. retained. Both separate Rav titles are full, and רבינו is the explicit possessive our master.
